question: Which geometry-only capability features drive the bounded raw-price change when adding the blocked direct ray?
changed_premise: The default Evaluator component check showed the ray changes per-type raw and normalized prices even when the geometry has no root action; source inspection shows raw price is composed from empty-board capability features.
measurement: For the deterministic selected type per frozen root, build base/ray MovementCapabilityProfile under the same default EvaluationConfig and compare expected mobility curve, empty-board out-degree, coverage, reachable-pair ratio, average shortest path and directional asymmetry. Reconcile computed raw-capability delta to the saved evaluator profile raw delta.
interpretation: Geometry-only attribution for this fixed 6x6 preset and ray template, not a general value theorem.
